verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs include a section titled "View and enforce your data quality" and an "Ensure data quality" heading, which signals a schema/plan enforcement capability. The pack contains only these headings, with no detail on how violations are handled. missing for 10: documented tracking-plan/schema definition, explicit behavior for violating events (flag vs. block vs. quarantine), per-source or per-environment enforcement detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
